aggregate.description:
A hierarchical grouping for organizing products in the catalogue.

Categories form a tree up to 5 levels deep (0-4). Each category can have a
parent, custom attributes, and a display order for controlling presentation.
aggregate.name: Category

catalogue.category.management.CreateCate.description: Add a new category to the product hierarchy.
catalogue.category.management.CreateCate.name: CreateCategory

catalogue.category.management.Deactivate.description: Deactivate a category, hiding it from the storefront.
catalogue.category.management.Deactivate.name: DeactivateCategory

catalogue.category.management.ReorderCat.description: Change a category's display position in the hierarchy.
catalogue.category.management.ReorderCat.name: ReorderCategory

catalogue.category.management.UpdateCate.description: Change a category's name or attributes.
catalogue.category.management.UpdateCate.name: UpdateCategory

catalogue.category.events.CategoryCreate.description: A new product category was added to the catalogue hierarchy.
catalogue.category.events.CategoryCreate.name: CategoryCreated

catalogue.category.events.CategoryDeacti.description: A category was deactivated and hidden from the storefront.
catalogue.category.events.CategoryDeacti.name: CategoryDeactivated

catalogue.category.events.CategoryDetail.description: A category's name or attributes were changed.
catalogue.category.events.CategoryDetail.name: CategoryDetailsUpdated

catalogue.category.events.CategoryReorde.description: A category's display position was changed.
catalogue.category.events.CategoryReorde.name: CategoryReordered

aggregate.description:
A sellable item in the catalogue, identified by a unique SKU.

The Product aggregate groups variants, images, pricing, and SEO metadata
into a single transactional boundary. Its lifecycle follows a forward-only
state machine: Draft -> Active -> Discontinued -> Archived. A product must
have at least one variant before activation.
aggregate.name: Product

catalogue.product.creation.CreateProduct.description: Add a new product to the catalogue in Draft status.
catalogue.product.creation.CreateProduct.name: CreateProduct

catalogue.product.details.UpdateProductD.description: Change a product's title, description, brand, attributes, or SEO metadata.
catalogue.product.details.UpdateProductD.name: UpdateProductDetails

catalogue.product.images.AddProductImage.description: Upload a new image for a product.
catalogue.product.images.AddProductImage.name: AddProductImage

catalogue.product.images.RemoveProductIm.description: Remove an image from a product's gallery.
catalogue.product.images.RemoveProductIm.name: RemoveProductImage

catalogue.product.lifecycle.ActivateProd.description: Make a draft product available for sale (requires at least one variant).
catalogue.product.lifecycle.ActivateProd.name: ActivateProduct

catalogue.product.lifecycle.ArchiveProdu.description: Archive a discontinued product for permanent storage.
catalogue.product.lifecycle.ArchiveProdu.name: ArchiveProduct

catalogue.product.lifecycle.DiscontinueP.description: Remove an active product from sale.
catalogue.product.lifecycle.DiscontinueP.name: DiscontinueProduct

catalogue.product.variants.AddVariant.description: Add a new purchasable variant (size, color, etc.) to a product.
catalogue.product.variants.AddVariant.name: AddVariant

catalogue.product.variants.SetTierPrice.description: Set a loyalty-tier-specific discount price on a variant.
catalogue.product.variants.SetTierPrice.name: SetTierPrice

catalogue.product.variants.UpdateVariant.description: Change the base price of an existing variant.
catalogue.product.variants.UpdateVariant.name: UpdateVariantPrice

catalogue.product.product.Image.description:
A visual representation of a Product, with URL and display ordering.

A product may have up to 10 images, with exactly one marked as primary.
The first image added is automatically set as primary.
catalogue.product.product.Image.name: Image

catalogue.product.product.Variant.description:
A purchasable configuration of a Product, such as a specific size or color.

Each variant has its own SKU, pricing (with optional tier discounts), and
physical attributes (weight, dimensions). A product must have at least one
variant to be activated for sale.
catalogue.product.product.Variant.name: Variant

catalogue.product.events.ProductActivate.description: A draft product was activated and made available for sale.
catalogue.product.events.ProductActivate.name: ProductActivated

catalogue.product.events.ProductArchived.description: A discontinued product was archived for permanent storage.
catalogue.product.events.ProductArchived.name: ProductArchived

catalogue.product.events.ProductCreated.description: A new product was added to the catalogue in Draft status.
catalogue.product.events.ProductCreated.name: ProductCreated

catalogue.product.events.ProductDetailsU.description: A product's title, description, brand, or attributes were changed.
catalogue.product.events.ProductDetailsU.name: ProductDetailsUpdated

catalogue.product.events.ProductDisconti.description: An active product was discontinued and removed from sale.
catalogue.product.events.ProductDisconti.name: ProductDiscontinued

catalogue.product.events.ProductImageAdd.description: A new image was uploaded for a product.
catalogue.product.events.ProductImageAdd.name: ProductImageAdded

catalogue.product.events.ProductImageRem.description: An image was removed from a product's gallery.
catalogue.product.events.ProductImageRem.name: ProductImageRemoved

catalogue.product.events.TierPriceSet.description: A loyalty-tier-specific price was set on a variant.
catalogue.product.events.TierPriceSet.name: TierPriceSet

catalogue.product.events.VariantAdded.description: A new purchasable variant was added to a product.
catalogue.product.events.VariantAdded.name: VariantAdded

catalogue.product.events.VariantPriceCha.description: A variant's base price was updated.
catalogue.product.events.VariantPriceCha.name: VariantPriceChanged

catalogue.product.product.Dimensions.description:
Physical dimensions (length, width, height) of a product or variant.

Supports centimeters (cm) and inches (in) as measurement units.
catalogue.product.product.Dimensions.name: Dimensions

catalogue.product.product.Price.description:
The monetary cost of a variant, with optional loyalty-tier discounts.

Base price is the standard retail price. Tier prices (stored as JSON) allow
different pricing for Silver, Gold, and Platinum customers. Tier prices must
always be lower than the base price.
catalogue.product.product.Price.name: Price

catalogue.product.product.SEO.description:
Search engine optimization metadata for a product page.

Contains meta title (max 70 chars), meta description (max 160 chars), and a
URL-safe slug. The slug must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens only.
catalogue.product.product.SEO.name: SEO

catalogue.product.product.Weight.description:
Physical weight of a product or variant, used for shipping calculations.

Supports kilograms (kg), pounds (lb), grams (g), and ounces (oz).
catalogue.product.product.Weight.name: Weight

catalogue.shared.sku.SKU.description:
Value object for stock keeping unit codes.

Format: alphanumeric + hyphens, 3-50 chars.
E.g., "ELEC-PHN-001", "SHOE-RUN-BLK-42"
catalogue.shared.sku.SKU.name: SKU
